INTERVAL '1' DAY)) plan_end_date FROM dirrx_projec1_prjctactivity a JOIN ActualProjectPlanVersionNumbers v ON a.projectplan = v.projectplanid WHERE (a.typeactivity = 'Task' OR a.typeactivity = 'Milestone') AND a.numberversion = v.versionnumber AND a.projectplan IN (@projectPlanIds) GROUP BY plan_id ) , RootTaskIds AS ( SELECT MIN(id) id FROM sungero_wf_task WHERE discriminator = '1dfb1055-aaf3-4722-8b6f-9d85c64b32aa' AND projectplan_projec1_dirrx IN (@projectPlanIds) GROUP BY activityrefid_projec1_dirrx ) , CompletedTasks AS ( SELECT t.id, t.activityrefid_projec1_dirrx refid, DATE(MAX(h.historydate)) enddate FROM sungero_wf_task t LEFT JOIN sungero_wf_workflowhistory h ON t.id = h.entityid WHERE t.id IN (SELECT id FROM RootTaskIds) AND t.status = 'Completed' AND h.operation = 'CompleteTask' GROUP BY t.id ) , StartedTasks as ( SELECT t.id , t.activityrefid_projec1_dirrx refid , t.started startdate , t.ActualWorkload_Projec1_DirRX actualworkload , t.FactualCosts_Projec1_DirRX factualcosts , t.ExecutionPerce_Projec1_DirRX executionpercent FROM sungero_wf_task t WHERE t.id IN (SELECT id FROM RootTaskIds) AND t.status NOT IN ('Draft', 'Aborted') ) , FactualActivityData AS ( SELECT a.projectplan plan_id , SUM(CASE WHEN started.refid IS NOT NULL THEN COALESCE(started.factualcosts, a.factualcosts, 0) ELSE COALESCE(a.factualcosts, 0) END) AS fact_cost , SUM(CASE WHEN started.refid IS NOT NULL THEN COALESCE(started.actualworkload, a.actualworkload, 0) ELSE COALESCE(a.actualworkload, 0) END) AS fact_workload , ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN started.refid IS NOT NULL THEN COALESCE(started.executionpercent, 0) ELSE COALESCE(a.executionperce, 0) END)) AS fact_percent , DATE(COALESCE(MIN(started.startdate), MIN(a.startdate))) AS fact_start_date , DATE(MAX(COALESCE(completed.enddate, (a.enddate - INTERVAL '1' DAY)))) fact_end_date FROM dirrx_projec1_prjctactivity a JOIN (SELECT ProjectPlanId, MAX(VersionNumber) lastversion FROM AllVersionInfo GROUP BY ProjectPlanId) v ON a.projectplan = v.ProjectPlanId LEFT JOIN StartedTasks started ON a.refid = started.refid LEFT JOIN CompletedTasks completed ON a.refid = completed.refid WHERE (a.typeactivity = 'Task' OR a.typeactivity = 'Milestone') AND a.numberversion = v.lastversion AND a.projectplan IN (@projectPlanIds) GROUP BY plan_id ) SELECT p.plan_id, fact_percent, plan_cost, fact_cost, plan_workload, fact_workload, plan_start_date, fact_start_date, plan_end_date, fact_end_date FROM PlannedActivityData p JOIN FactualActivityData f ON p.plan_id = f.plan_id;
